identity.title: ALMA Observations of Gas-rich Galaxies in z ∼ 1.6 Galaxy Clusters: Evidence for Higher Gas Fractions in High-density Environments

paper_type_evidence.quote: We present ALMA CO (2–1) detections in 11 gas-rich cluster galaxies at $z\sim1.6$, constituting the largest sample of molecular gas measurements in $z>1.5$ clusters to date.

question.value: Do cluster galaxies at z~1.6 have different molecular gas fractions and depletion timescales than coeval field galaxies, and how does the gas fraction evolve in clusters?

evidence.quote: We compare our cluster galaxies to the scaling relations of the coeval field, in the context of how gas fractions and depletion timescales vary with respect to the star-forming main sequence.
